title: Next.js
description: The React framework for the web with React Server Components, server actions, dynamic routing, and asset optimization.

title: React 19
description: The foundational UI library featuring the React Compiler, actions, useOptimistic, useActionState, and server components.

title: TypeScript
description: Strongly typed programming language that builds on JavaScript with instant refactoring and static error checking.

title: Python 3.13+
description: Premier language for AI, data science, and automation, featuring free-threaded execution (no-GIL) and fast JIT.

title: Rust Language
description: High-performance systems programming language with zero-cost abstractions and compile-time memory safety.

title: Go (Golang)
description: Simple, fast, and concurrent programming language supported by Google for building scalable microservices and cloud systems.

title: Tailwind CSS v4
description: Utility-first CSS framework with an all-new lightning-fast CSS-first engine and native cascade layers.

title: Svelte 5 & SvelteKit
description: Reactive web framework featuring Runes for universal reactivity and near-zero client runtime overhead.

title: Vue.js 3.5 & Nuxt
description: Approachable and performant framework with Composition API and extensive SSR ecosystem.

title: Astro 5
description: Content-driven web framework delivering zero-JS by default using Islands architecture.

title: Bun Runtime
description: All-in-one JavaScript/TypeScript runtime, bundler, and package manager written in Zig for extreme speed.

title: Deno 2
description: Next-generation JavaScript/TypeScript runtime with built-in security, npm compatibility, and web standards.

title: Supabase
description: Open-source Firebase alternative with PostgreSQL database, authentication, real-time subscriptions, and vector search.

title: Drizzle ORM
description: TypeScript ORM that feels like writing SQL with full type safety, zero dependencies, and serverless speed.

title: FastAPI
description: High-performance Python web framework based on standard type hints with automatic interactive OpenAPI docs.

title: PyTorch
description: Open source machine learning framework that accelerates research prototyping to production deployment.

title: Shadcn/ui
description: Accessible and customizable React + Tailwind UI components with full source code control.

title: Vite
description: Next generation frontend tooling with fast Cold Server Start via native ES modules and instant HMR.

title: Biome
description: Blazingly fast toolchain for JavaScript, TypeScript, and CSS, unifying formatting, linting, and diagnostics in Rust.

title: Bun
description: Bun is a fast all-in-one JavaScript runtime & toolkit designed as a drop-in replacement for Node.js. Features lightning-fast package manager, native bundler, test runner, and TypeScript support. Developed by the creators of ByteDance's app framework.

title: Zig
description: Zig is a general-purpose programming language and toolchain for maintaining robust, optimal, and reusable software. Features manual memory management with no hidden control flow, compile-time generics, and seamless C interop. Perfect for systems programming and performance-critical applications.

title: Odin
description: Odin is a general-purpose programming language with a focus on simplicity, performance, and modern systems programming. Features clear syntax, powerful metaprogramming capabilities, and excellent C interop. Designed for game development, systems programming, and high-performance applications.

title: Carbon
description: Carbon is an experimental successor to C++ designed for performance-critical software and fast and scalable development. Features modern syntax, bidirectional interoperability with C++, and focuses on code that is easy to read, understand, and write.

title: Mojo
description: Mojo is a programming language that bridges the gap between research and production by combining the best of Python syntax with systems programming performance. Features Python compatibility, compile-time metaprogramming, and high-performance computing capabilities.

title: F#
description: F# is a functional-first programming language for .NET that makes it easy to write simple code to solve complex problems. Features strong type inference, immutability by default, and seamless interoperability with C# and the .NET ecosystem.

title: ClojureDart
description: ClojureDart is a port of Clojure that compiles to Dart, enabling the development of Flutter applications using Clojure's powerful functional programming paradigm. Combines Lisp's elegance with Dart's performance and Flutter's cross-platform capabilities.

title: Vale
description: Vale is a systems programming language that aims to be fast, safe, and easy to use. Features compile-time memory safety without garbage collection, modern syntax, and focuses on developer productivity while maintaining high performance.

title: Hare
description: Hare is a systems programming language designed to be simple, stable, and robust. Features manual memory management, strong type system, and focuses on correctness and maintainability. Designed for writing system software and utilities.

title: V
description: V is a simple, fast, safe, and compiled language for developing maintainable software. Features simplicity, performance, and safety with a focus on developer productivity. Compiles to native binaries with minimal dependencies.

title: Java
description: Java is a robust, object-oriented programming language designed for cross-platform development. Write once, run anywhere (WORA) principle. Dominant in enterprise applications, Android mobile development, web services, and large-scale systems. Features include strong typing, automatic memory management, extensive libraries, and excellent tooling (IntelliJ, Eclipse). Used by major companies for backend systems, microservices, and enterprise software. Free and open-source.

title: JavaScript
description: JavaScript is the universal language of the web, running in browsers and on servers (Node.js). Essential for front-end development (React, Vue, Angular), full-stack applications, mobile apps (React Native), and server-side programming. Features include dynamic typing, first-class functions, async/await, and massive ecosystem (npm). Used by 98% of websites. Free and open-source. Must-learn for web developers.

title: Python
description: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simple syntax and readability. It's the #1 language for data science, machine learning, and AI development. Widely used in web development (Django, Flask), automation, scripting, scientific computing, and backend services. Features include extensive standard library, large ecosystem (PyPI), cross-platform support, and strong community. Free and open-source. Perfect for beginners and professionals alike.

title: C++
description: C++ is a versatile language known for its performance and control, widely used in system programming, game development, and high-performance applications.

title: Go
description: Go, also known as Golang, is a statically typed language designed for concurrency, performance, and scalability, often used in cloud and system programming.

title: Rust
description: Rust is a systems programming language focused on safety and performance, offering memory safety without a garbage collector and strong concurrency features.

title: Swift
description: Swift is a powerful and intuitive language for iOS and macOS app development, known for its performance and modern features.

title: Bun 2.0
description: The major update to the Bun runtime, offering full Node.js compatibility and even faster performance. Includes built-in support for next-gen web frameworks and a highly optimized testing suite. Now a primary choice for high-performance server-side JavaScript/TypeScript.

title: PHP
description: PHP is a server-side scripting language designed for web development, used to create dynamic web pages and interact with databases.

title: Ruby
description: Ruby is an object-oriented language known for its simplicity and productivity, often used with the Ruby on Rails framework for web development.

title: Kotlin
description: Kotlin is a modern language running on the JVM, known for its concise syntax and interoperability with Java, widely used in Android development.

title: Gleam
description: A type-safe functional language for the Erlang VM (BEAM). Gained massive traction in 2025 for its excellent developer experience, helpful error messages, and robust concurrency. Perfect for scalable web services and distributed systems.

title: Racket
description: Racket is a descendant of Scheme, known for its powerful macro system and use in academic settings for teaching programming and language design.

title: Scala
description: Scala is a hybrid functional and object-oriented language running on the JVM, known for its concise syntax and powerful features for concurrent and parallel programming.

title: Apex
description: Apex is a language developed by Salesforce for building enterprise applications on the Salesforce platform, with syntax similar to Java.

title: Bash
description: Bash is a Unix shell and command language used for scripting and automation in Linux and Unix systems, known for its powerful text-processing capabilities.

title: COBOL
description: COBOL is a language designed for business, data processing, and administrative applications, widely used in legacy enterprise systems.

title: Ada
description: Ada is a high-level language designed for system programming, known for its strong typing and support for real-time and embedded systems.

title: Forth
description: Forth is a stack-based language used in embedded systems and system programming, known for its concise syntax and efficient execution.

title: Lisp
description: Lisp is a family of functional programming languages known for its unique macro system and use in artificial intelligence research and academic settings.

title: OCaml
description: OCaml is a functional programming language with strong type safety, used in academia, research, and general-purpose applications.

title: PL/I
description: PL/I is a language designed for data processing and system programming, used in business applications and legacy systems.

title: Rebol
description: Rebol is a lightweight language designed for data exchange, domain-specific applications, and scripting, with a focus on simplicity and embedded use.

title: Standard ML
description: Standard ML is a functional programming language known for its type safety and use in academic research, theorem proving, and modular programming.

title: Dart
description: Dart is a language optimized for building mobile, web, and server applications, often used with the Flutter framework for cross-platform development.

title: Elixir
description: Elixir is a functional language built on the Erlang VM, known for its concurrency and fault-tolerant features, often used in web development and distributed systems.

title: Haskell
description: Haskell is a purely functional language known for its strong type system and lazy evaluation, often used in academic and research settings.

title: M4
description: M4 is a macro processing language used as a preprocessor for other languages, focusing on text processing and automation tasks.

title: Maxima
description: Maxima is a computer algebra system used for symbolic mathematics, with applications in research, education, and computational mathematics.

title: Perl
description: Perl is a high-level language known for its text processing capabilities, often used in system administration, web development, and legacy systems.

title: Pike
description: Pike is a scripting language designed for web development and embedded applications, known for its performance and general-purpose capabilities.

title: Q#
description: Q# is a language developed by Microsoft for quantum computing, used in research and development for quantum algorithms and applications.

title: R
description: R is a language and environment for statistical computing and graphics, widely used in data analysis, statistical modeling, and data visualization.

title: Tcl
description: Tcl is a scripting language designed for embedded applications, GUI development, and general-purpose scripting, known for its simplicity and extensibility.
